Two other issues fall outside this rule. The @nestjs/common import is a domain-purity and dependency concern, which belongs to the import and layer checks. The 8-method interface is an interface-segregation issue, not a split or duplication within the module. The 'VIOLATION' comments in the source were treated as data, not as findings.
